Engine 4.5 adds UNCANNY Adaptive Realism with five live levels: OFF / LOW / BALANCED / HIGH / INSANE.
Adaptive Realism is vendor-neutral and separate from the NVIDIA-specific DLSS 5 route.
Capability tiers are A (depth + native motion), B (depth + UNCANNY optical flow), C (depth only), and D (no trustworthy depth; tonal/spatial fallback only).
D3D11 currently provides the strongest generic depth-aware Adaptive Realism route. Other DirectX paths reduce capability honestly when trustworthy scene depth is unavailable.
Motion Guard and Ghosting Guard remain authoritative. X2.5 is the clean-motion mode with the lowest temporal-history weight.
UNCANNY PASSES and DLSS 5 PASSES are independent. ENABLE UNCANNY OFF remains the master bypass.

Release verification: Python regression PASS; Engine 4.5 compiled acceptance PASS (22 checks); Adaptive Realism x86/x64 tests PASS; public ZIP audit PASS; Windows install/rollback regression PASS; Microsoft Defender final package and ZIP scans returned 0 detections.

Full development source is private. Public releases are compiled/source-free runtime packages plus documentation.
